prompts.name: kubectl-apply-onboarding
prompts.prompt: We've been running our payments app in the `payments-prod` namespace for a year, applied with kubectl apply from a folder of YAMLs in git. No Helm, no Argo, no Flux. I want to move management into ConfigHub. Where do I start?

prompts.name: scope-choice
prompts.prompt: I want to import everything in the `backend` namespace into ConfigHub. Is that a good idea?

prompts.name: split-brain-risk
prompts.prompt: I have cert-manager installed via Helm in my cluster. Can I use cub unit import to get it into ConfigHub?
